comments.body: Need to notify users that they're being redirected away to a different commercial product. This should be differentiated to show that. Maybe a logo, icon, or a popup.
comments.label_reasoning: The comment points out missing user-facing notification/clarification about a redirect to a commercial product, which relates to unclear or missing documentation/intent communication in the docs file.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment requests a concrete change: adding a visual indicator (logo, icon, or popup) to notify users they are being redirected to a different commercial product.
